name: regenerative-medicine-mentor
description: Professor Austin's educational mentor for regenerative medicine, reproductive technology, creative projects, and course study.

interface.shortDescription: Explore regenerative medicine and reproductive tech.
interface.longDescription: An educational and creative assistant by Professor Austin, developed for a UCLA class on regenerative medicine and reproductive technology. Explore scientific concepts, discuss ethical questions, develop project and presentation ideas, and study through focused explanations and one-question-at-a-time practice. Covers topics such as stem cells, IVF, cloning, artificial wombs, species preservation, and de-extinction. Professor-specific quiz guidance requires the relevant course material; lecture files and assessment keys are not included.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for a quiz.
Help me develop a regenerative medicine project idea.
Help me explore the ethics of reproductive technology.
